riley: Quick check — saw a ~3x bump in 502s from eu-west for /v1/generate starting ~09:42 UTC. Any quick links for dashboards / sample traces? need a few request_ids for oncall. :eyes:

samir: Ping. If it's the gateway, check Errors Overview -> 'Gateway Errors by Route' panel. Dash link: https://dash.internal.redwood/g/err_overview?orgId=1&panelId=23 (use last 30m). For traces, try Jaeger search: https://traces.internal.redwood/search?service=gateway&tags=path%3A%2Fv1%2Fgenerate

lee: Also pull logs from Kibana: https://logs.internal.redwood/app/kibana#/discover?_a=(query:(query_string:(query:'status:502 AND path:"/v1/generate"')))&_g=(time:(from:now-30m,to:now))
Use this quick query in Discover: ```status:502 AND path:"/v1/generate" | sort @timestamp desc | limit 50```

maria: If you want raw request_id samples, use the incident helper: ```incctl sample-requests --service gateway --path /v1/generate --status 502 --limit 20 --out request_ids.txt```

riley: perfect, thx. prod-gw-5xx-alert fired too — any quick tuning suggestions?

samir: prod-gw-5xx-alert is pretty global, so it can be noisy on short deploy spikes. My quick proposal: scope the threshold for /v1/generate, increase window, and debounce. For example: ```threshold: 2.5%  window: 5m  debounce: 10m  scope: path=/v1/generate``` Also add a recent-deploy tag so alerts suppress for 10m after a rollout event.

lee: +1 to widening the window. Also check gateway node CPU and connection queues — Grafana: https://dash.internal.redwood/g/cpu_nodes?var-region=eu-west
If node-level queue length is high, that points to overload rather than model slowness.

maria: I can backfill 30m of traces and attach 3 request samples. Want me to do that @riley?

riley: yes please, that would help. I'm posting a short note in #incidents too.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-20260317-013 — assigned to eng-platform. Link: https://inc.internal.redwood/INC-20260317-013

maria: uploaded 3 request_ids: rq_8a2, rq_9c3, rq_b11 — traces attached (gateway->model-proxy span shows 504 at span-child).

riley: grabbing the traces now. If we see repeated timeouts at gateway->model-proxy, we'll escalate to eng-runtime.

lee: If you want me to, I can mute prod-gw-5xx-alert for 15m while we triage.

riley: please mute for 15m, thanks :thumbsup:

maria: leaving notes in the incident with the Kibana query, trace links, and the suggested alert rule change.
